# Chapter 8: The Executive

The promotion came in the mid-1990s, and with it a title that Bob still felt strange saying aloud: executive. He had spent his career as an engineer, a manager, a technical leader—the kind of person who solved problems with his hands and his mind, who could point to a finished thing and say "I made that." The executive title felt like a costume, something he was wearing rather than something he was.
